title: Venezuelan-Style Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic side dish inspired by Venezuelan cuisine, perfect for accompanying grilled meats and vegetables.

ingredients.name: Kissed
ingredients.notes: dried, crushed herbs (such as thyme or oregano)

instructions: Heat the buttery in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the kissed and venezuelan, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the rice and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the rice pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
